title: Custom football kits for an amateur / grassroots club
meta_title: Custom Kits for an Amateur Football Club | MOMUTO
meta_descript: Kit out your amateur / grassroots football club: custom design, printed sponsors, every size, and when to order before the season. No minimum order.
content:
Quick answer

To kit out an amateur / grassroots football club, MOMUTO builds a kit around your identity (colours, crest, sponsors), in polyester/elastane with full dye-sublimation, from kids’ XS to adult 4XL, no minimum order. Draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days.

A kit with the club’s identity, not the catalogue

A grassroots club deserves a strong identity. Instead of an off-the-shelf template, you start from your colours and crest. Three routes: the free 3D configurator, the Ready-to-Play collection at −10%, or a custom design from a concept (a sketch, your colours, or even an AI design).

Sponsors: fund the order without breaking the bank

Most amateur clubs fund their kit through local sponsorship. Sublimation prints a shop’s or company’s logo on the chest, sleeves or back at no extra cost and no risk of peeling. One sponsor often covers a large part of a squad order. See funding your kits.

A mixed squad, one order

Seniors, youth, keepers, reserves: the range runs from kids’ XS to adult 4XL, so you can dress the whole club at once with a consistent look. Check the size guide.

Order at the right time

Regional competitions usually start in late summer. With 25–30 days of production and delivery, the useful window is mid-July to mid-August. Detail in the complete guide.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a minimum order for a grassroots club?

No — from a single jersey to the full squad. The price drops with quantity (down to €21.90/jersey from 10).

Can we print several sponsors?

Yes: chest, sleeves and back. Sublimation prints each logo into the fabric, permanently.

What about the youth sides?

Same kit, same colours, from kids’ XS to adult 4XL: the whole club stays consistent.
